Trump's NATO summit actions focus on Turkey, F-35 jets, and Ukraine

At a NATO summit, US President Donald Trump announced the lifting of sanctions on Turkey and indicated a potential sale of F-35 fighter jets, a move that could resolve Turkey's exclusion from the program following its acquisition of Russian air defense systems. Trump also commented on the Ukraine war, suggesting a resolution is nearing, and engaged in discussions with other leaders, including criticism of some allies' stances on Iran. Meanwhile, NATO allies are increasing investment in anti-drone capabilities.
